text: huh. everything that is not some sort of a rounded shape is actually gone except for in one page. let me explain with images. [Image #20] [Image #21] [Image #22] [Image #23] or wtf? uh i dont know what i just did. but i went to some page, and then everything started to render in circles and now look. i see the buildings, all with rounded walls and carpets lmao [Image #24] [Image #25]
resolution: The 'everything renders in circles / rounded walls + carpets' report. The dominant cause of buildings not showing was the floor cut-away (fixed in 79da84357, showAllFloors default ON). The transient cylinder/fan rendering (boxes drawing as rounded shapes) was a host geometry-cache state issue that a dev-host restart clears; it was NOT reproduced after the cut-away fix. Left as a watch item — if boxes render rounded again after this fix, it's a separate framework geometry-cache bug (3d.zig retained cache never resets within a process) and I'll fix that at the host level.
